title: Website Penetration Testing (VAPT)
shortLine: We safely test your website the way a real attacker would, with your permission, to find vulnerabilities before attackers can exploit them.
whatItIs: We safely test your website the way a real attacker would, with your permission, to find vulnerabilities before attackers can exploit them.
whoItIsFor: Business websites, schools, clinics, startups and e-commerce stores that want to confirm their public site and hosting setup do not leave easy doors open.
whatYouReceive: Manual and automated security testing within an agreed scope
Checks on common vulnerabilities, SSL and security headers
Risk classification for each finding in plain language
Detailed technical report and practical remediation recommendations

title: Web Application Security Testing
shortLine: We assess login systems, user accounts, forms, databases and application functions for gaps that could expose data or allow misuse.
whatItIs: We assess login systems, user accounts, forms, databases and application functions for gaps that could expose data or allow misuse.
whoItIsFor: Organisations running customer portals, student or employee management systems, booking platforms, admin dashboards or custom web applications.
whatYouReceive: Authentication, session and access-control testing
OWASP-based vulnerability assessment across forms, roles and workflows
Proof of impact captured safely without disrupting real users
Clear remediation steps your developers can apply quickly

title: API Security Testing
shortLine: APIs are the connections that let your software systems talk to each other. We find the weaknesses in them before someone else does.
whatItIs: APIs are the connections that let your software systems talk to each other. We find the weaknesses in them before someone else does.
whoItIsFor: Web applications, mobile app backends, SaaS platforms and e-commerce stores that connect to payment gateways, mobile clients or third-party tools.
whatYouReceive: Endpoint authentication and authorisation checks
Assessment for sensitive data exposure and broken object access
Validation and rate-limiting review across agreed endpoints
Technical report with actionable API hardening guidance

title: Network Security Assessment
shortLine: We assess servers, routers, computers and network infrastructure for weaknesses that could let an attacker in.
whatItIs: We assess servers, routers, computers and network infrastructure for weaknesses that could let an attacker in.
whoItIsFor: Offices, schools, clinics and growing companies running internal servers, Wi-Fi networks, cloud servers or exposed services.
whatYouReceive: Network discovery and exposed-port mapping within scope
Server and device security configuration checks
Vulnerability scanning verified by human review
Prioritised risk report and practical remediation recommendations

title: Red Team Assessment
shortLine: An authorised attack simulation that shows how well your organisation detects and responds to a real attack.
whatItIs: An authorised attack simulation that shows how well your organisation detects and responds to a real attack.
whoItIsFor: Organisations with established systems and security controls that want to test real-world detection, alerting and incident response readiness.
whatYouReceive: Authorised attack simulation built around agreed scenarios
Evaluation of security detection and response procedures
Evidence trail showing what succeeded and where defenders spotted activity
Separate executive summary and technical remediation reports

title: Cloud Security Assessment
shortLine: We review cloud configurations, access permissions, storage and exposed services, where one wrong setting can expose your data.
whatItIs: We review cloud configurations, access permissions, storage and exposed services, where one wrong setting can expose your data.
whoItIsFor: Startups, SaaS teams and businesses hosting files, databases or applications on cloud platforms.
whatYouReceive: Review of storage buckets, public exposure and network rules
Identity and access permission review (least-privilege checks)
Service configuration review against practical security baselines
Prioritised action checklist to lock down exposed settings

title: Mobile Application Security Testing
shortLine: We assess Android and iOS apps for security weaknesses that could put your users or business at risk.
whatItIs: We assess Android and iOS apps for security weaknesses.
whoItIsFor: Businesses, e-commerce brands, clinics, schools and startups offering customer or staff apps on Android or iOS.
whatYouReceive: Assessment of local data storage, session handling and app transport security
Review of how the app communicates with its backend APIs
Identification of insecure secrets or debug settings inside builds
Clear technical report with developer-ready fixes

title: Malware Analysis
shortLine: Found a suspicious file or program? We investigate how it behaves and what risk it poses, so you know what you are dealing with.
whatItIs: We investigate suspicious files and software to understand their behaviour and risk.
whoItIsFor: Businesses or system administrators who found an unknown script, attachment, modified website file or suspicious executable.
whatYouReceive: Isolated inspection of suspicious files or scripts
Plain-language explanation of what the file attempts to do
Indicators and risk level assessment
Practical next steps for containment and cleanup

title: Security Auditing
shortLine: A structured review of your security configurations, practices and controls, with clear recommendations to close the gaps.
whatItIs: A structured review of security configurations, practices and controls.
whoItIsFor: Business owners, institutions and growing teams who want an honest baseline review of their digital controls and readiness practices.
whatYouReceive: Structured review of current configurations, access practices and safeguards
Gap summary highlighting highest-risk areas first
Practical recommendations suited to your team size and budget
Clear documentation to support internal security tracking

title: Incident Investigation
shortLine: Think you have been compromised? We help investigate suspected security incidents: what happened, how, and what to do next.
whatItIs: We help investigate suspected security incidents and compromises.
whoItIsFor: Organisations noticing unauthorised logins, website defacement, unexpected redirects, suspicious files or suspected data exposure.
whatYouReceive: Structured investigation into what happened and likely entry points
Evidence preservation guidance and timeline summary
Practical steps to stop ongoing misuse and secure accounts
Recommendations to reduce the chance of repeat incidents
